quests.title: Stand on the gem
quests.ask: Walk the robot along its row until it is standing on the gem's cell.
quests.nudge: Count the cells the robot crosses. What does each line do to where it stands?

quests.title: Pick up the gem
quests.ask: With the robot standing on the gem, pick it up so the floor is empty.
quests.nudge: The robot does exactly what the lines say, in order. What comes after the walking?
